16398               	;
16399               	; 	' THE COLOUR TABLE, 472 bytes of the same value ($14 = black ink on dark blue).
16400               	; 	'
16401               	; 	' Loaded with DEFINE COLOR 32,59,font_col, which is ONE synchronous call that
16402               	; 	' writes all three screen thirds (define_color always does the LDIRVM3 triple
16403               	; 	' copy). It replaced a VPOKE loop that wrote this one value 1,416 times paced by
16404               	; 	' 24 WAITs -- the largest scripted delay in the boot, and the reason the title
16405               	; 	' screen used to fill in visibly rather than appearing at once.
16406               	; 	'
16407               	; 	' EIGHT BYTES PER CHARACTER, not one. Supply fewer and DEFINE COLOR reads
16408               	; 	' whatever follows in ROM as colour data, with no error at build or run time.
16409               	;
16410               	; font_col:
16411               cvb_FONT_COL
16412               	; 	DATA BYTE $14,$14,$14,$14,$14,$14,$14,$14	' space
16413 6202 1414     	byte >14,>14,>14,>14,>14,>14,>14,>14

16734               	; 	' AND THE TITLE'S DISPLAY LIST, for the same reason as the font: walked
16735               	; 	' once by title_draw, at boot and on a return to the title, and never
16736               	; 	' during play. title_draw selects bank 2 around its walk.
16737               	; 	'
16738               	; 	' ITS MESSAGE BOXES DID NOT COME WITH IT. They are the same format and
16739               	; 	' were in the same generated file, which is what made this worth doing
16740               	; 	' carefully: they are walked when a ROUND ENDS, mid-game, so on bank 2
16741               	; 	' they would have returned bytes from the wrong page at the moment a life
16742               	; 	' is lost -- and with no error at build or run time. gentitle.py now
16743               	; 	' writes them to title.bas below, which stays in bank 1.
16744               	; 	INCLUDE "titledl.bas"
16745               	; 	' ==================================================
16746               	; 	' THE TITLE SCREEN, AS A DISPLAY LIST
16747               	; 	' Generated by assets/gentitle.py -- do not edit here.
16748               	; 	'
16749               	; 	' row, col, length, then `length` bytes; 255 ends.
16750               	; 	' Walked by title_draw only.
16751               	; 	'
16752               	; 	' LIVES IN BANK 2, with the fonts, because it is read ONCE
16753               	; 	' -- at boot and on a return to the title. title_draw
16754               	; 	' selects bank 2 around its walk and restores bank 1.
16755               	; 	' The message boxes in title.bas are the same format and
16756               	; 	' CANNOT come with it: they are read when a round ends.
16757               	; 	' ==================================================
16758               	;

16952               	; 	INCLUDE "art.bas"
16953               	; 	' Keystone Kapers art -- GENERATED by assets/genart.py. Do not edit; regenerate.
16954               	; 	'
16955               	; 	' EVERY SPRITE IS 16x16: sprite size and magnification are GLOBAL on the
16956               	; 	' TMS9918, so small objects are drawn small INSIDE a 16x16 box rather than
16957               	; 	' being small sprites.
16958               	; 	'
16959               	; 	' EVERY 8-PX OBJECT SITS IN ROWS 8-15 OF ITS BOX, ducked Kelly included, so
16960               	; 	' one rule places them all: bottom edge = y + 16, and a thing resting on the
16961               	; 	' floor is at y = FLOORY - 16.
16962               	; 	'
16963               	; 	' Sprite bytes are QUADRANT-ORDERED: 16 rows of the left half, then 16 of
16964               	; 	' the right. Every block is an EVEN number of bytes -- an odd DATA BYTE run
16965               	; 	' silently misaligns every word table after it (CLAUDE.md 3A).
16966               	;
16967               	; spr_kelly:	' Kelly: RIGHT hat/face/the four merged run bodies/duck hat/face/body, then the same LEFT (+36). The run bodies carry tunic AND legs, so a frame is one sprite. Patterns 0..68
16968               cvb_SPR_KELLY

18208               	; 	INCLUDE "store.bas"
18209               	; 	' Keystone Kapers store -- GENERATED by assets/genstore.py. Do not edit.
18210               	; 	'
18211               	; 	' EIGHT band templates of 5 rows x 32 cols (160 bytes each) plus a 32-byte
18212               	; 	' index over (level, screen). The whole 8-screen, 4-level building is about
18213               	; 	' 1.3 KB instead of the 5,120 bytes it would cost to store literally.
18214               	; 	'
18215               	; 	' All eight templates are ONE contiguous block under ONE label, so a band
18216               	; 	' blit is
18217               	; 	'     SCREEN stor_tpl, tpl*160, toprow*32, 32, 5, 32
18218               	; 	' with no label ladder -- SCREEN needs a literal label and a label cannot be
18219               	; 	' chosen by a variable, which is why RallyX needed a 4-way IF over its maze
18220               	; 	' tables. One block sidesteps it.
18221               	; 	'
18222               	; 	' 160 is EVEN, so this cannot leave the location counter odd and misalign
18223               	; 	' the word tables defined after it.
18224               	; 	'
18225               	; 	' template ids:
18226               	; 	'   0 T_AISLE_A
18227               	; 	'   1 T_AISLE_B
18228               	; 	'   2 T_ESC_W
18229               	; 	'   3 T_ESC_E
18230               	; 	'   4 T_ELEV
18231               	; 	'   5 T_ROOF0
18232               	; 	'   6 T_ROOF1
18233               	; 	'   7 T_ROOF2
18234               	; 	'   8 T_ROOF3
18235               	; 	'   9 T_ROOF4
18236               	; 	'   10 T_ROOF5
18237               	; 	'   11 T_ROOF6
18238               	; 	'   12 T_ROOF7
18239               	; 	'   13 T_END_W
18240               	; 	'   14 T_END_E
18241               	;
18242               	; stor_tpl:	' 15 templates x 160 bytes
